title: Pollyanna
author: Eleanor H. (Eleanor Hodgman) Porter
longDescription: Porter is a novel published in 1913. When eleven-year-old orphan Pollyanna arrives to live with her stern Aunt Polly in a small Vermont town, she brings with her "The Glad Game"—finding something positive in every situation, no matter how difficult.

authorInfo.bio: Eleanor H. (Eleanor Hodgman) Porter (1868–1920) is the author of Pollyanna. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
